name: Power Knight Pro Fiber - 120ml
description:
Power Knight Pro-Fiber Damaged Hair Recovering Mask – 120ml

Brand: Power Knight
Place of Origin: Guangdong, China

Key Features:

Hair Protein (Keratin) – Helps repair and strengthen damaged hair

Smoothing & Detangling – Makes hair soft, manageable, and tangle-free

Cream Formula – Easy to apply and absorbs effectively

Size: 120ml – Ideal for regular use

Benefits:

Restores damaged and weak hair

Improves hair texture, leaving it smooth and silky

Protects hair from breakage and split ends

Enhances shine and manageability
